title: Senior Credit Manager - Special Projects
description:
Do you know Bunge?

Distributed in more than 40 countries, a world leader in oilseed processing and one of the largest producers and suppliers of vegetable oils, fats, and proteins for more than two centuries, Bunge works to connect farmers to consumers to provide essential food, ingredients, and fuels for the world. With 117 years in Brazil, we have more than 100 units and are one of the main agribusiness and food companies, a leader in grain origination and soybean and wheat processing. In all our value chains, we promote our business while supporting the social and economic well-being of the communities where we operate.

We value the diversity of our teams and seek creative talents with team spirit and a desire to make a difference. In everything we do, we put our values into practice:
• Act as one team, promoting inclusion, collaboration, and respect;
• Seek excellence, being agile, innovative, and efficient;
• Do what is right, acting in a safe, ethical, and sustainable manner.

At Bunge, we value diversity in all its forms and work towards an inclusive and belonging culture with respect and equity. Here, everyone is welcome as they are!

Our company has a solid track record, and we are building a future full of opportunities! Be part of our team and follow your professional journey with us.

Summary:

This Senior Credit Manager – Special Projects position is a highly strategic role responsible for leading and executing complex credit-related initiatives within the organization. The incumbent will provide expert credit analysis and risk assessment for Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A), oversee credit management for Joint Venture partnerships, manage the credit application process of the company’s financial statement analysis application, and contribute to other special projects as needed. This role requires deep expertise in credit management, a strong understanding of Brazilian agribusiness, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to effectively collaborate with senior management.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Mergers & Acquisitions:
    • Conduct comprehensive due diligence and credit analysis on target companies.
    • Identify and quantify key credit risks and opportunities and participate in the structuring of credit solutions in M&A transactions.
    • Develop and present credit risk assessments and recommendations to senior management.
    • Support the integration of acquired companies into existing credit processes.
  • Joint Venture Partnerships:
    • Provide guidance for credit analysis and risk management practices for joint venture partnerships.
    • Develop and implement credit policies and procedures for joint ventures.
    • Monitor the credit performance of joint venture partners.
    • Provide guidance and training to joint venture partners on credit-related matters.
  • Financial Statement Analysis Application:
    • Manage the credit application process associated with the company’s financial statement analysis application.
    • Ensure the application effectively captures and analyzes relevant credit data.
    • Monitor the application’s performance and identify areas for improvement.
    • Collaborate with IT and other stakeholders on application development and maintenance.
  • Special Projects:
    • Contribute credit expertise to various special projects as they arise.
    • Provide credit risk assessments and recommendations for strategic initiatives.
    • Support the development and implementation of new credit products and services.
  • Leadership and Collaboration:
    • Interact effectively with executive-level managers, providing clear and concise credit information.
    • Collaborate with other leaders across commercial, finance, legal, and other departments.
    • Lead and mentor credit team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA preferred.
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in credit management, including experience with M&A, joint ventures, and credit application processes.
  • Thorough understanding of the agricultural business and associated credit risks in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to manage, motivate, and mentor teams.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Proficiency in both Portuguese and English languages.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the needs of the organization. This job description is current as of 2025-06-03 and is subject to change.

description:
A Creditas é uma plataforma de serviços financeiros que a partir da casa, carro e salário oferece empréstimos, seguros e investimentos. Com 12 anos de atuação, é a maior plataforma de crédito online da América Latina e recebeu aportes de fundos internacionais, levantando mais de R$4 bilhões (US$879 milhões) em equity e com um portfólio atual de R$5,6 bilhões. Por meio da sua tecnologia proprietária oferece produtos como o empréstimo com garantia de automóvel ou imóvel, o consignado privado, benefícios corporativos e seguros. A Creditas já ultrapassou a marca de 13 milhões de solicitações de crédito, um valuation de US$3,5 bilhões e mais de 40 emissões no mercado de capitais (FIDCs, CRIs e FIIs).

Nosso time de Product Technology

É com ela que escalamos o negócio, otimizamos processos, reduzimos custos e entregamos a melhor experiência para viabilizar novas conquistas de nossos clientes.

Com tecnologia desenvolvida dentro de casa, trabalhamos com várias linguagens de programação do mercado. Ideal para quem, assim como a gente, ama se desafiar e se desenvolver na resolução de problemas reais.

Se tecnologia também é seu combustível e fazer a diferença é a sua paixão, embarque com a gente na Nave!

Quais são as responsabilidades desta vaga:

  • Apoiar os squads no dia a dia, sendo uma referência técnica para as pessoas desenvolvedoras, pareando e participando da implementação de soluções ou revisão de código das pessoas desenvolvedoras;
  • Analisar o estado atual das soluções, identificando possíveis gargalos técnicos e dificuldades da tribo, a fim de diagnosticar problemas de forma proativa, antes de se tornarem incidentes ou problemas maiores;
  • Visão clara das expectativas do negócio para os próximos meses, bem como do roadmap de produto para o curto e médio prazo;
  • Visão voltada para o futuro, direcionando a tribo no caminho correto do ponto de vista técnico para atingir os objetivos do negócio;
  • Exercer liderança técnica e guiar as squads na execução da estratégia definida para a tribo, trazendo o ponto de vista técnico para as discussões estratégicas e o ponto de vista estratégico para as discussões técnicas.

Precisamos de alguém com :

  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação backend (Java, Python, Ruby, Go, etc);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacional e não relacional NoSQL;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensageria (Kafka, AWS-SQS etc);
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos;

title: Engineering Manager, Device Intelligence - Brazil
description:
Engineering Manager, Device Intelligence - Brazil

About the Team

The Identity Intelligence team's mission is to eliminate threats and empower the growth of the DoorDash business by providing the source of truth for User Identity and the relationships of connected identifiers. We provide protection across DoorDash's external-facing endpoints. We are making dedicated investments into this space to drive major business impact for teams across DoorDash.

Our team is foundational and sits at the intersection of many other teams, serving critical needs related to user identification, attestation, and device intelligence. We envision our systems to be highly reliable, providing the source of truth for identity-related data with high quality, invaluable, and accurate information. This empowers teams to make the best business decisions, whether solving for fraud or unlocking growth.

We are focused on building extensible platforms, enabling teams to easily and quickly leverage the systems to build critical features. Improving engineering velocity with self-serve tooling and seamless end-to-end integrations that can deliver data insights from the client to the backend system is a key priority.

Our domain currently includes:

  • Identity Graph: Providing the source of truth for User Identities and relationships between all entities.
  • Attestation: Ensuring all requests to DoorDash servers are legitimate, including protection against bot traffic.
  • Device: Uniquely and accurately identifying physical devices that access DoorDash and providing device-related insights.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, Identity Intelligence, you will oversee a talented group of engineers, collaborating closely with designers, product managers, operations, and other cross-functional partners. Your primary responsibility will be driving the successful execution of our product roadmap, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions that meet both customer needs and business objectives. You will be key in fostering a collaborative and cross-functional work environment and promoting effective communication and synergy amongst team members. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills who can balance technical excellence with business priorities, especially in the critical domain of identity and security. You will report into Arjun Mukhopadhyay ( ).

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead and grow a team of exceptional engineers, empowering through delegation, and delivering end-to-end engineering solutions for Identity Intelligence systems.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business leaders, and key stakeholders to determine the team's roadmap and vision, and manage execution against that roadmap, focusing on the strategic technical vision for Identity Graph, Attestation, and Device Intelligence.
  • Provide architectural guidance and professional development for a team of 5+, particularly in the context of building reliable, scalable, and extensible platforms for identity data.
  • Encourage innovation, teamwork, implementation of cutting-edge technologies (including ML-based solutions), and outside-of-the-box thinking to address complex identity and security challenges.
  • Oversee the hiring process for your team, in partnership with recruiting, to grow a diverse and inclusive team with expertise in areas like distributed systems, data engineering, and security.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • BS, M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management leading backend teams of 5+ engineers including a staff engineer.
  • 7+ years of industry experience.
  • Experience working with remote teams in different time zone(s) and fluency in English.
  • Extensive experience as an engineer in a fast-paced, product-focused development environment.
  • Experience with distributed system design, system scaling, and performance optimization, especially in the context of data-intensive and security-critical systems.
  • Hands-on leadership and strong product intuition, with a keen understanding of identity and security concerns.
  • Humility - willing to get into the details and open to feedback.
  • Growth mindset - you're eager to expand your skill set and excited to carve out your career path in a hyper-growth setting.
  • Adaptability, resiliency, and ability to thrive in ambiguity - things can change quickly, and you'll need to help the team evolve.
  • Familiarity with concepts related to Identity Graph, Attestation, and Device Intelligence
  • Understanding of data quality, monitoring, and analytics in the context of identity data.
  • Interest in exploring and implementing ML-based solutions for identity and security challenges.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Agente Stone - Consultor(a) Comercial Externo | Curitiba/PR
description:
Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  1. Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  2. Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  3. No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  4. Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  5. The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O maior diferencial da Stone é ser uma companhia totalmente centrada no cliente. E para garantir que o(a) empreendedor(ra) foque no crescimento do seu negócio, construímos escritórios próprios (polos) por todo o Brasil, entregando presencialmente as soluções mais eficazes do mercado.

Nosso time de Agentes Stone está todos os dias lado a lado da nossa razão, os donos e donas de negócio, apoiando cada um deles em sua jornada empreendedora, garantindo total comprometimento em resolver os seus problemas e a melhor experiência de atendimento ao(à) cliente do país.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento.

  • Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes mantendo um relacionamento contínuo e pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser maior de idade.
  • Desejável experiência comercial.
  • Saber se comunicar muito bem.
  • Muita energia e paixão por servir o nosso cliente.
  • Buscar a excelência em tudo que se propor a fazer.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: médicos, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, na palma da sua mão
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e video aulas (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Rota Teste: Nosso objetivo é que você vivencie a rotina proposta na vaga na prática, ou seja, você acompanhará um(a) dos(as) nossos(as) agentes durante a sua rota.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Além das vagas afirmativas, todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

title: IT Security Specialist III
description:
Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

As an IT Security Specialist III, you will be responsible for ensuring Amcor has proper visibility, detection, and protections to secure Amcor. Your primary responsibilities will involve strategic input on the IT Security roadmap and delivery of our comprehensive security strategy. The role is also responsible for global

information security design and integration to ensure technology implementations are configured securely and appropriately. The candidate will have a broad understanding of information security concepts and experience with implementing many technical security controls. This role is the senior most technical expert on all matters of security, works at the direction of the IT Security Manager, and collaboratively with others. Previous experience with automation and SOAR platforms required

Key Job Accountabilities

Lead global technical IT security strategy including metrics, program improvements, and innovative

ways to mitigate business risk while improving security

Apply knowledge of threats, vulnerabilities, risk, and technical systems to build strategic roadmaps to

harden systems and close vulnerabilities

Design and implementation of automation, security architecture, standards and new technology.

Develop system maintenance procedures to ensure proper health of all security technology.

Conducting risk assessments to identify gaps and recommending mitigation strategies.

Be a thought leader in security engineering and operations delivery - driving automation, analytics, and advanced threat analysis

Evaluate current or emerging technologies to consider factors such as cost, security, compatibility, or usability to ensure proper alignment with global security strategy

Play a key role in the identification, assessment, prioritization and remediation processes of cyber security risks and vulnerabilities · Drive transformation from detective controls to preventative controls where possible

Critical contributor in building and adopting new security technologies while supporting day-to-day security activities from incident handling and response, security monitoring, alerting, and more

Lead technical expert of the Security Incident Response Team, contributes to the execution of the incident management plan in response to active security incidents, and aides in the collection and preservation of evidence while following chain-of-custody best practices

Mentor and guide junior security team members

Actively participate in a 24x7 delivery team, which may include on-call and weekend work

Qualifications/Requirements

8+ years relevant experience

Bachelors – IT or related field or comparable work experience

Preferred – CISSP or similar technical certifications

Strong experience in maintaining healthy operations of security tooling and infrastructure

Extensive experience in developing automation (SOAR) processes and scripting knowledge

Demonstrated technical experience in related security disciplines such as intrusion detection and

Strong ability to prioritize and track multiple projects in parallel

Amcor is a global leader in packaging solutions for consumer and healthcare products. With industry-leading innovation capabilities, global scale and technical expertise, we help our customers grow and meet the needs of millions of consumers every day. Our teams develop responsible, more sustainable packaging in flexible and rigid formats across multiple materials. Supported by a commitment to safety, ~70,000 colleagues across ~140 countries bring our global capabilities to local customers and provide local access to global brands. Our work is guided by our purpose of elevating customers, shaping lives and protecting the future.

Avenida das Nações Unidas, 12901,11° andar São Paulo

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

  • Participar de treinamentos para adquirir conhecimentos técnicos essenciais para sua função como consultor e manter-se atualizado sobre as últimas inovações tecnológicas do mercado.

Requisitos:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Mais do que um curso específico, valorizamos curiosidade intelectual, autonomia e dinamismo.
  • Interesse por Dados e Negócios: Paixão por desafios empresariais e pelo uso de Big Data e Analytics para resolver problemas reais e impulsionar mudanças estratégicas.
  • Mentalidade Analítica e Prática: Capacidade de compreender desafios de negócios e propor soluções personalizadas baseadas em dados.
  • Habilidade de Comunicação e Colaboração: Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, compartilhar conhecimento e interagir com diferentes áreas e stakeholders.
  • Interesse pelo Ecossistema Digital e Tecnológico: Curiosidade por temas como metodologias ágeis, gestão de projetos, data visualization, ciência e engenharia de dados.
  • Proatividade e Espírito Empreendedor: Você propõe novas ideias, busca inovações e está sempre disposto a aprender e contribuir ativamente para a equipe.

O que oferecemos:

  • Free office: Trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais: Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba: Pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!
  • Avaliações semestrais: Com oportunidade de promoção.

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.

title: [Talent Pool] Investor XP | Belo Horizonte
description:
(Talent Pool) Investor XP | Belo Horizonte

Belo Horizonte

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre, e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

// Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenas e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Belo Horizonte . Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024, com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Gera insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;

// Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

// Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial em Belo Horizonte e proximidades.
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos na XP Inc.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante que todos os colaboradores morarem na localidade da vaga, pois há atividades que exigem presença física para promover colaboração e cultura. Essas atividades são organizadas conforme orientações dos líderes e particularidades de cada rotina, promovendo autonomia.

title: Data Engineer, Corporate Data
description:
At DoorDash, people are our most important asset. We build the capability to help our leaders make more informed decisions on identifying, attracting, developing, and retaining talent. We’re looking for a Data Engineer to help us scale our analytics alongside DoorDash’s enormous growth. Come build, experiment, and grow while shaping a best-in-class data team at DoorDash.

About the Role

DoorDash is seeking an experienced data engineer to join our People Analytics team. We’re a data-driven organization, empowering local economies and our people to do the best work of their careers. This role will get in on the ground floor helping to build and support the data infrastructure powering our data-driven insights to attract, develop, and retain the best talent to power and grow DoorDash. You will support and scale our people reporting and analytics within the People Team. In this role, you will partner with a team of analysts, scientists, and engineers to develop the tools and insights for our people and decision-makers. Come help us enable our business to garner insights and be a builder, engineer, consultant, and security/privacy advocate.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Architect and engineer our data infrastructure for People data
  • Design and implement data warehouse schemas, tables, and views to provide a source of true datasets
  • Develop ETL pipelines using tools such as Airflow and dbt for data profiling, cleaning, and transformation
  • Support self-service analytics projects by creating secure data structures
  • Provide underlying data support for all People metrics (recruiting pipelines, attrition, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion, compensation and benefits, etc.)
  • Ensure data integrity across all People data
  • Rigorously document system requirements and configuration to build operational excellence
  • Understand and identify opportunities to improve, working closely with cross-functional teams
  • Train peers on new processes and functionality as needed
  • Help build data governance with a single source of truth

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of industry experience in data engineering or software engineering
  • Experience deploying cloud architecture like dbt, Airflow, and Databricks in AWS
  • Expert SQL skills and experience writing complex queries
  • Proficiency authoring Airflow DAGs
  • Experience with data observability and monitoring frameworks
  • Strong business thinker, able to use ‘first principles’ to solve challenging business problems at their root level
  • Data-driven, able to analyze data with strong attention to detail and accuracy, and passionate about telling the story behind the data hence turning the data into insight

title: Senior Audit Manager, FinCrime (LACC)
description:
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by Crypto, ultimately contributing to every individual's freedom.

OKX began as a crypto exchange giving millions of people access to crypto trading and over time becoming among the largest platforms in the world. In recent years, we have developed one of the most connected Web3 wallets used by millions to access decentralized crypto applications (dApps).

OKX is a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets on a reliable platform that seamlessly connects with global banking and payments. In the last year, OKX has expanded into new markets including Australia, Brazil, Netherlands, Singapore and Turkey, with plans to launch in the US, Belgium and the UAE.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Recruiting - Brazil
description:
About the Team

The DoorDash Recruiting Team is focused on building DoorDash culture, one quality hire at a time. We partner with hiring teams to execute recruiting strategies that help DoorDash to hire qualified candidates in the most efficient and unbiased ways.

We're looking for a Sr. Manager of Technical Recruiting to oversee our hiring efforts as we build out our São Paulo, Brazil location. DoorDash is growing and scaling at an unprecedented rate, and you will play a critical role in helping shape the technical recruiting function as we build to fully realize DoorDash’s dream: to grow and empower local economies. We’re focused on improvement — from moving faster to leveling up the quality of our product — and our work is never complete. If you’re looking to define your career as part of something greater than yourself, come scale with us.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well-being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Role

The Sr. Manager, Technical Recruiting - Brazil will be responsible for developing and driving our recruiting strategy at scale. You will lead the hiring strategy and execution across our technical hiring teams investing in Brazil, and report directly to the Sr. Director, Technical Recruiting in our People organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Lead DoorDash’s technical recruiting strategy in São Paulo with a focus on acquiring top diverse talent to meet our current and future hiring needs.
  • Attract, develop, and retain recruiters of all levels and capabilities, with a focus on industry knowledge and innovation.
  • Deploy forecasting, reporting, and analytics rigor to track key recruiting metrics and measure progress against team OKRs (objectives and key results).
  • Deliver ongoing reports to track results, impact, hiring quality, and cost-effectiveness of the recruiting team.
  • Use information to detect trends/insights and adjust the strategy to optimize the impact of the team.
  • Proactively communicate strategy updates and team productivity to recruiting leadership and hiring teams.
  • Provide expert guidance to our leaders and hiring managers to attract, select, onboard, and retain highly-skilled candidates.
  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of processes, tools, and systems needed to scale and support the recruiting team in both the short and long term.
  • Focus on building out proactive hiring strategies supporting org design, succession planning, and always-on talent pipeline.
  • Develop employment brand opportunities and partner with our cross-functional teams to create one-to-many strategic talent engagements with prospective talent pools.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have at least 10 years of recruiting or equivalent business experience, with at least 5 years of experience leading and managing high-performing teams within a hyper-growth environment at progressive companies.
  • You are proficient in both English and Portuguese.
  • You are an authentic, inspiring and hands-on leader with experience driving, building and scaling recruiting teams in hyper-growth environments.
  • You are a beacon for the best recruiters — they seek you out and will follow you anywhere.
  • You build trusted relationships with people at all levels, across multiple functions and in all geographies.
  • You have a bias for action and have an inner drive and fierce commitment to excel in the pursuit of business goals.
  • You possess a penchant for seeking out new experiences, knowledge, and candid feedback and an openness to learning and change.
  • You have the courage to take on difficult goals and bounce back from adversity in the face of challenges.
  • You have an understanding of technology and/or logistics industries and extensive experience leading in-house, geographically dispersed recruiting teams.
  • You're skilled at using data and analytics to develop insights and drive decisions.
  • You have a strong point of view on how diversity and inclusion play a key role in a company’s success, track record of leading teams to achieve diversity recruiting goals, and proven success working with internal and external diversity partners.
  • You have adaptable and superior communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation) at all levels (individual contributor to executive level).

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Relatório de Transparênciae Igualdade Salarial de Mulheres e Homens

Em cumprimento ao determinado pela Lei 14.611/2023, publicamos o Relatório de Transparência e Igualdade Salarial de Mulheres e Homens elaborado pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, relativo aos dados do ano de 2022.

Esclarecemos que mesmo apoiando os princípios de igualdade plena de direitos e obrigações entre mulheres e homens e mais especificamente a igualdade de critérios de remuneração independentemente de qualquer distinção de sexo, etnia e quaisquer outros fatores discriminatórios, o relatório do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego que estamos publicandonão cumpre totalmente seu objetivo de aferir a igualdade salarial e de critérios remuneratórios entre mulheres e homens para a realização de trabalho de igual valor ou no exercício da mesma função. Isso acontece porque o relatório não compara remunerações para as mesmas funções, mas para grupos de funções de características e complexidade extremamente distintas. Por isso, acreditamos que as conclusões do relatório elaborado pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Empregonão refletem a realidade de nossa empresa em relação aos critérios de remuneração efetivamente adotados para o exercício da mesma função por mulheres e homens.

A fim de melhor atender aos princípios de transparência e igualdade previstos na Lei, estamos buscando pelos meios adequados o aperfeiçoamento, por parte do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, do tratamento dos dados de remuneração fornecidos pela empresa.

title: Director, Analytics Enablement
description:
RAPP Dallas is looking for a Director, Analytics Enablement to join our award-winning Marketing Sciences team.

WHO WE ARE:

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As aglobal, next-generation precision marketing agencywe leveragedata, creativity, technology, and empathyto foster client growth.We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help tocreate value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.
Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.
Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

YOUR ROLE:

The Director, Analytics Enablement supports the collection and activation of analytics data across RAPP client projects, providing consultation and technical solutions to fulfill measurement and reporting goals. This person will architect, build, and maintain tracking implementations, conventions and taxonomies, and technical documentation leveraging best practices in digital analytics. Additionally, the Director will act as a resident expert on the collection of accurate data through experience in a variety of platforms including ESPs, digital media, web analytics, and tag management systems. At RAPP, Analytics Enablement exists at the intersection between analytics and technology, as a critical capability of our Marketing Sciences division.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Directly interfaces with client and partner contacts, communicating in a manner to inspire confidence while maintaining detailed documentation following all discussions
  • Authors client-facing business-centric documents including well-designed presentations, BRDs, use cases / user stories, and issue post-mortems
  • Performs discovery of client marketing and technology ecosystems, business goals, and personnel resources
  • Authors and maintains campaign naming and URL tagging conventions and taxonomies
  • Conducts tag management implementation and validation through platforms including Google Tag Manager and Ensighten
  • Advises on CRM and email marketing measurement using tools including Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Litmus Email Analytics
  • Advises on mobile app measurement and attribution instrumentation for platforms including Branch MMP, AppsFlyer, Kochava, and Adjust
  • Advises on digital media tracking based on experience with Google Marketing Platform (Campaign Manager, DV360, and Ads), other DSPs, Microsoft Ads, Facebook Ads, Pinterest Ads, Twitter Ads, and LinkedIn Ads
  • Conceives of tracking architecture for client initiatives and campaigns, producing flow diagrams and technical specifications, thereby allowing both digital and offline interactions to be tracked, analyzed, and optimized
  • Authors tracking and tagging implementation documentation for client in-house teams, client/agency partners, and internal development resources, including clear details that can be easily translated into a test plan for tracking QA purposes
  • Provides comprehensive validation of all tracking implemented across client initiatives to ensure measurement accuracy

REQUIREMENTS

  • At least 7-10 years of analytics and technology experience, preferably 3+ years with an Advertising, Marketing, Analytics, or Digital Media firm
  • An understanding of core marketing analytics concepts including impressions, clicks, pageviews, events, sessions, users, conversions, lookback windows, and attribution models
  • Experience working in support of CRM and digital media analytics, in particular working within the various popular platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Litmus Email Analytics, Branch.io MMP, Google Ads, GCM, DV360, Bing, and Facebook)
  • Experience utilizing enterprise tag management systems to support the deployment of web and media analytics tracking tags on pageview-based websites, single-page applications, and mobile apps; Google Tag Manager and Ensighten are preferred; Adobe Launch and Tealium iQ are also valuable
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting Adobe Analytics Report Suites including Classification Sets, Rules, Importer, and eVars / sProps
  • Experience administering Google Analytics 4; Accounts and Properties, including the creation of Custom Dimensions, Key Events, and Audiences
  • Experience with A/B/multivariate website testing tools including Adobe Target
  • Experience with enterprise taxonomy management tools; Claravine is preferred; Accutics, Taxo, Terminus, Airtable, and Smartsheet are also valuable
  • Adobe Analytics Implementation Certification and Google Analytics Individual Qualification a plus
  • Experience with the architecture and deployment of mobile tracking solutions, including SDK integration, server-postbacks, and MMP (mobile measurement providers) a plus
  • Innovative Problem-Solving & Commitment : Ability to solve complex measurement and business challenges through creativity, while maintaining a commitment to self-driven continuing education to remain current on techniques, vendors, and the wider marketing landscape
  • Presentation & Public Speaking : Ability to produce client-ready written documents and presentation decks along with strong public speaking skills to facilitate positive in-person client meetings
  • Personal Traits : Ability to execute inspiring work with minimal supervision; passionate about problem solving in the areas of marketing, data, analytics, and technology; excellent verbal and written communication skills

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

RAPP provides a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits plan. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), stock options, Healthcare & Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts, vacation, sick, and personal days and positive activism days, paid parental leave and disability benefits. For more information regarding Omnicom benefits, please visit . A reasonable estimate of the salary for this role, at the time of posting, is $128,000 - $153,000. This range is specific to Dallas and multiple factors are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to: skill set, experience and training, certifications; etc. This is an exempt position. If your requirements fall outside of this range, you are still welcome to apply.

description:
Brasília/DF

Vaga Permanente

Segmento: Educação Infantil, Ensino Fundamental I e II e Ensino Médio

DESCRIÇÃO SINTÉTICA DO CARGO:

  • Responsabilizar-se, em parceria com as Coordenações Pedagógicas de Segmento, pelo planejamento e implantação da proposta pedagógica;
  • Realizar a gestão da sua unidade de negócio (segmento) garantindo a sustentabilidade e os resultados, considerando a excelência acadêmica;
  • Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos alunos nos níveis cognitivo, psicosexual, afetivo e social;
  • Promover a parceria Escola/Família.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  1. Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com a equipe pedagógica, com foco nos resultados garantindo a implementação da proposta pedagógica:
    1. Implementa, junto com a equipe pedagógica, o planejamento anual em conformidade com o projeto pedagógico do colégio.
    2. Participa, junto ao Serviço de Orientação Religiosa, do planejamento dos dias de formação e convivência.
    3. Colabora com informações relevantes no processo de avaliação de professores, em parceria com as CPS’s, a partir do acompanhamento realizado aos estudantes.
    4. Promove estudos que propiciem a qualificação e atuação dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
    5. Responsabiliza-se pelo processo de enturmação de estudantes.
    6. Mantém parceria constante com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento quanto ao processo de intervenção e acompanhamento dos estudantes junto aos professores.
    7. Elaborar em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento os processos de organização dos Conselhos de Classe.
    8. Conduz os Conselhos de Classe, orientando as discussões.
    9. Cumpre o Plano de Metas estabelecido a partir da Avaliação de Desempenho.
  2. Realizar gestão de processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento da aprendizagem dos estudantes considerando a excelência acadêmica:
    1. Prioriza no plano operacional da unidade, as atividades específicas de sua função conforme a proposta pedagógica.
    2. Estabelece foco na condução profissional das suas atividades.
    3. Monitora o andamento da realização do plano de ação, visando à revisão de estratégias em tempo hábil.
    4. Realiza análises quantitativas e qualitativas para respaldar as ações de intervenção junto aos alunos e às famílias.
    5. Implementa ações que propiciem o processo de autorregulação de aprendizagem.
    6. Orienta os professores para o acompanhamento do desempenho dos estudantes, especialmente aqueles com necessidades educativas especiais.
    7. Efetiva projetos de formação de liderança e protagonismo juvenil em parceria com a coordenação do SOR.
    8. Sistematiza processo de autoavaliação dos estudantes.
    9. Realiza projetos, junto aos estudantes, a partir de uma visão integradora dos segmentos.
    10. Registra os processos sob sua responsabilidade.
    11. Acompanha o desenvolvimento da aquisição das habilidades cognitivas dos estudantes, incentivando-os na construção dos hábitos de estudos.
    12. Monitora criteriosamente o trabalho dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
    13. Zela pelo cumprimento dos códigos de disciplina e ética dentro da escola.
  3. Promover a parceria Escola/Família na condução do processo educacional:
    1. Colabora com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento na realização de reuniões com os pais.
    2. Inova no atendimento às famílias buscando a fidelização dos estudantes.
    3. Estrutura com a equipe pedagógica uma linha de ação para a inclusão dos estudantes com necessidades educativas especiais e suas famílias.
    4. Colabora na acolhida e orientação dos estudantes novatos.
    5. Encaminha às famílias, por escrito, quaisquer medidas disciplinares adotadas pela unidade em relação ao estudante.

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS:

  • Conhecimentos na área pedagógica adquiridos em pós-graduação lato sensu.
  • Conhecimentos na área de neurociências adquiridos em pós-graduação lato sensu.
  • Conhecimento tecnológico.
  • Gestão de projetos.
  • Processos relacionados à metacognição e à autorregulação.
  • Gestão de conflitos.

Additionally, it will be essential to ensure that VTEX's content is always up to date and that customers receive the best information about the company's products and solutions. Your work will have a special focus on SEO optimization, ensuring that each piece is relevant and well-positioned in search engines. You will also support press release validation and spokesperson training.

To succeed in this position, it is essential to have clear and effective communication, be organized, and take the initiative in automating content workflows. Experience with tools such as HubSpot and Semrush will be a plus.

What you will do

  • Create customer case studies, ensuring impactful narratives aligned with VTEX's objectives.
  • Develop content for blogs, eBooks, social media, and email marketing campaigns for CRM.

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️

Adnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Líder de Operações ficará responsável por liderar a equipe de operadores de equipamentos e auxiliares de rampa, atuando com assertividade na gestão de pessoas e processos operacionais para promover o desenvolvimento do grupo e do setor, além de garantir aderência da equipe às normas, políticas e procedimentos do departamento e da empresa.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para oAeroporto de Salvador (SSA)!


Main responsibilities

  • Liderar a equipe de operadores de equipamentos e agentes de bagagem e rampa, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional do grupo (formação de sucessores), coordenar as atividades e processos inerentes ao atendimento de aeronaves em solo (chegada e partida), atuando em conjunto com as demais áreas envolvidas na operação visando garantir a pontualidade do voo com qualidade e segurança, segundo as normas e procedimentos publicados no MGO, realizar o procedimento de inspeção visual na fuselagem da aeronave nas chegadas e partidas (walkaround);
  • Coletar, compilar e compartilhar antecipadamente com os demais colaboradores da equipe, dados e informações referentes à operação a ser processada, definir e atribuir responsabilidades ao grupo de trabalho de maneira planejada, analisando a operação “in loco”, estabelecendo objetivos de acordo com a priorização de demandas e atividades;
  • Analisar as irregularidades ou situações de risco identificadas, atuando na correção e prevenção através da realização de briefings operacionais e do reporte para demais setores envolvidos;
  • Identificar e reportar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de rampa, seja de maneira micro e/ou macro, realizar briefings operacionais e comportamentais, promover reuniões, dar feedback;
  • Coordenar todas as atividades pertinentes à movimentação de equipamentos de rampa durante o descarregamento e carregamento de bagagens e cargas das aeronaves, orientando os colaboradores durante as operações quanto à logística de atividades, análises de sinistralidades e agindo frente a possíveis ocorrências a fim de evitar rupturas operacionais e perda de qualidade nos serviços executados.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior é um diferencial;
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no pacote office;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;
  • Capacidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, locomoção e deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto e para condução do veículo para transportes internos no pátio do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução de veículo a serviço da empresa (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro), suporte à equipe e acompanhamento das atividades operacionais, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

When our team founded Insider, they not only sought to create a product company but also to build the most socially progressive technology community in the world. Through our corporate social responsibility initiatives like 100Projects SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact into our communities across 27+ countries, spearheading transformative projects in areas such as health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing the proportional representation of women in STEM careers.

Behind all these achievements, there is an exceptionally talented and passionate team across 27+ countries that moves fast and agile, creates cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to join us on this journey, just keep reading.

First things first: What is this role about?

You’re probably expecting an eye-catching, mesmerizing job description that will sweep you off your feet, flavoured with the coolest startup jargons. After all, we’re a Sequoia-backed company, with an awarded woman CEO and a team across the globe that takes the word “diversity” very seriously. But that’s exactly why we think that nothing says more than the real experience. We’re underdogs who believe in the power of actions more than anything else. And as a customer-first company, we always walk the extra mile.


Job Description:
  • Become an expert in Insider products
  • Make recommendations on supporting sales strategies, integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution, providing “best practice” advice to customers to optimize Insider effectiveness
  • Proactively monitor our partners’ activities, facilitate and provide on-time and around the clock insights and solutions to the partners
  • Provide exemplary pre-sales technical expertise through technical and product presentations, demonstrations, pilot implementations, and ongoing sales consultation
  • Lead account services strategy in generating and developing business growth opportunities, working collaboratively with product, partner success and sales teams across various product pillars to maximize business results with clients
  • Develop a deep understanding of both the customers and competitive landscape, enabling a business dialogue to be conducted with C-level contacts and their teams
  • Outstanding professional, sales, and technical capabilities; comfortable supporting both enterprise (field) and inside sales teams on targeted accounts
  • Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills
What we expect from you:
  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher (E.g. Marketing, Business, Psychology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or other related field.)
  • Cherish one of our core ethoses: care. You’ll need to care for our partners and make sure they feel at home with our products and our assistance
  • Able to work under tight deadlines
  • Proven ability to learn quickly in a very fast-paced environment
  • Be a self-motivated and savvy tech bug, always in search for savvy solutions and ideas to improve our relationship with our clients
  • High energy, self-starter, be a visionary seller comfortable with ambiguity in entrepreneurial environments
  • Must be a team player - ability to interact with teammates and partners fairly, and respectfully proactive / results-driven / strong problem solving skills. Highly dependable, team player with high energy, positive attitude and with great organization and time management skills
  • Masterful in delivering software demonstrations, whether in-person, or via web presentation
  • Solid understanding of basic web concepts and digital marketing
  • Possess "best of breed" functional sales experience that could be applied across an entire sales area in general or specific functional categories
Hold on! Life’s a two-way road! Here’s what you’ll enjoy while spending time with us (perks, anyone?)
  • We offer many hard and soft skills training to help you improve and challenge yourself. You’ll have access to Udemy’s business plan, where you can choose over 10,000 courses to satisfy your hunger for knowledge.
  • You’ll have space to share your skills and even deliver training and workshops if you wish. Sharing is caring!
  • Spotify account subscription, so you can cozy up in your headsets cocoon whenever you want.

  • You’ll be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences. Still not sure? Just ask Google.
  • Occasional happy hours!

Is this position made for you?

So let’s talk! We’re curious bugs and can’t wait to get to know you.

Some of the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies and top brands in retail, automotive and travel across the globe use Insider to deliver AI-backed personalized experiences. title: Customer Onboarding Manager - (Implementation Project Manager) - Brazil
description:
Before jumping in on all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

We are Insider, a B2B SaaS company that drives growth for its clients around the world. How are we achieving this? We are the #1 AI-native platform for Customer Experience and Marketing—offers marketers a single platform to deliver unique experiences per person, drive profitable growth, and unleash peak productivity and efficiency. Our platform connects data across channels, predicts future behavior with AI, and individualizes experiences from a single platform.

We have just celebrated our $500M Series E funding round, led by General Atlantic . Before this, we’ve unlocked unicorn status following our Series D round. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 1200+ brands from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Coca-Cola, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Virgin, Nestle, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Dominos, CNN, and the list goes on.

Having unlocked unicorn status, Insider was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world, to achieve $200M in CARR (Committed Annual Recurring Revenue). Insider was named a leader in The Forrester Wave for Cross-Channel Campaign Management 2021, and Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omnichannel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023 Assessment. The company has been recognized in The Top 1% of all software companies worldwide in G2’s 2024 Software Awards , and named in The Top 10 Best Software Products with the most #1 rankings alongside other software legends like Google, Zoom, and Monday.com . According to G2’s Spring’24 reports. Insider is also the #1 G2 Leader in 6+ categories , including Customer Data Platforms (CDP), Personalization Engines, Personalization Software, Mobile Marketing, Customer Journey Analytics, and e-commerce Personalization.

When our team founded Insider, they not only sought to create a product company but also to build the most socially progressive technology community in the world. Through our corporate social responsibility initiatives like 100Projects SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact into our communities across 27+ countries, spearheading transformative projects in areas such as health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing the proportional representation of women in STEM careers.

Behind all these achievements, there is an exceptionally talented and passionate team across 27+ countries that moves fast and agile, creates cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to join us on this journey, just keep reading.

As a Customer Onboarding Manager , you will be responsible for driving the onboarding process, ensuring successful and timely outcomes for new clients. Your role is crucial in accelerating Time to Value and ensuring customer retention by helping clients fully integrate and realize the value of Insider’s platform.

You will collaborate closely with internal technical resources to empower and train customers on how to use Insider’s platform and its powerful features as efficiently as possible. Establishing strong, credible relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the client organization will be key to understanding their business and technical goals.

Role Expectations:

You will be expected to have a technical background , which could be gained through either academic education or relevant work experience. This includes the ability to read API documentation , knowledge of HTML, CSS, and XML , and the ability to understand basic data structures and data flows .

You will be prioritized if you have experience with short to medium-term projects and strong project management skills , as your role will heavily focus on managing multiple projects simultaneously.


Qualifications:
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in SaaS project management and client onboarding .
  • PM qualifications such as Agile, PMP, or Prince2 are a plus.
  • Strong communication skills , both written and verbal, with business fluency in English .
  • Time and task management skills are essential.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders .
  • Demonstrated success in delivering projects in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager, Google Product Feed , and Google Analytics is an advantage.
  • Understanding of webhooks and API .
  • Exposure to and understanding of AI-driven product recommendation tools and algorithms is a plus.
  • Experience with other CRM, ERP, or Marketing Automation platforms is an advantage.
Responsibilities:
  • Project management of customer onboardings to ensure successful outcomes, accelerating Time to Value and driving customer growth and retention.
  • Collaborate with internal technical teams to train customers on using Insider’s platform and features effectively.
  • Build credible relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from senior management to end users, to understand their business and technical goals.
  • Drive early adoption by setting KPIs and success metrics, ensuring full ROI for clients.
  • Advocate for customer business use cases with the product development team.
  • Ensure smooth transition to the Customer Success Manager team by documenting client stakeholder roles and hierarchy.
  • Continuously enhance the onboarding experience by improving processes and training materials.
  • Where needed, tailor 1:1 onsite and remote onboarding sessions to exceed client expectations.
  • Establish trust and confidence in Insider's platform, ensuring successful early adoption.
  • Coordinate effectively with client agencies and third parties to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Ensure the highest quality in deliverables, maintaining client satisfaction and facilitating a seamless post-onboarding transition to the Customer Success & Support teams.
  • Collaborate with the development team to ensure custom development meets client expectations and standards.
  • Own the project, taking responsibility for successful implementation while working closely with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate exceptional user-enablement training and workshops to empower clients.

We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

Centro-Oeste: Campo Grande-MS, Cuiabá-MT, Goiânia-GO;

Sudeste: São Paulo-SP, São José dos Campos-SP, Ribeirão Preto-SP, Campinas-SP, Piracicaba-SP, Belo Horizonte-MG, Triangulo Mineiro-MG, Sul-MG;

Sul: Porto Alegre-RS e Interior, Vale do Itajaí-SC, Londrina e região- PR;

Demais cidades: somente banco de talentos (Não há vagas atualmente, mas dependendo da necessidade de crescimento, podemos dar sequência no processo).

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita).

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

*Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

XDay: Dinâmica focada nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.

Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso proposito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Contract YouTube REAX Editor
description:
TBNR (T he B est N ever R est ) is a top YouTube Production Company that manages the massive YouTube channels and digital media brands of Preston , Brianna Arsement and more! Our YouTube channels have upwards of 60 million subscribers and 18 billion lifetime views. To work at TBNR Productions you must have a passion for YouTube with a drive to continuously grow and deliver the latest and greatest content! Our IRL channelsare on the lookout for talented video editors at all levels to join our trailblazing Post Production team. As an editor at TBNR Productions, you'll have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment where you can unleash your creativity, help us deliver the latest and greatest content to our viewers, and be part of the excitement and innovation happening here at TBNR!

WHO YOU ARE

  • YouTube obsessed and likes to have fun and be weird
  • A memer and pop culture junkie that understands how to grab and retain the viewer’s attention
  • A solutions oriented problem solver who isn't afraid of radical candor
  • A continued learner and seeker of further education to pursue growth
  • An excellent collaborator who fuels excitement
  • Someone who isn’t afraid to ask questions and spark change within themself and the Company
  • Someone with a positive disposition who learns from failure and recognizes wins

YOUR DIRECT RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create engaging and entertaining content that attracts and retains viewership, while also attracting new viewers
  • Edit video footage in both supervised and unsupervised environments, ensuring that all deadlines are met
  • Transform raw footage into a seamless and polished final product
  • Emphasize humorous and noteworthy moments
  • Stay up-to-date with and maintain a passion for IRL YouTube content, internet trends, memes, and graphics
  • Edit a rough cut of a video within the first day of receiving it
  • Familiarize oneself with each IRL channel's content and deliver content that meets its specific standards
  • Utilize After Effects and Photoshop to enhance and create video assets
  • Collaborate with the Post Supervisor to ensure that all QC notes are reviewed and implemented

GENERAL POST PRODUCTION REQUIREMENTS

  • Proficient background in editing IRL YouTube content
  • Ability to cut and trim content in a manner that enhances its entertainment value from beginning to end
  • Strong time management skills to ensure timely delivery of content that meets TBNR's quality and creative standards
  • Strong sense of urgency and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Expertise and efficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud software
  • Proficient in using Premiere as the preferred NLE (Non-Linear Editing) software
  • Experience with Photoshop and/or After Effects

FIRE PERKS (full time employees only)

  • 100% Company paid Medical Insurance
  • Company sponsored Dental and Vision Insurance
  • 401K with a 3% non-elective contribution from TBNR LLC that fully vests immediately
  • Flexible time off with 8 Company paid holidays

TBNR LLC is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment.
